label: G.652.D loose-tube 36F
notes: Three tubes of 12, TIA-598 tube colours 1-3 (blue, orange, green); engine/fiber.js addresses the strands T01-F01 to T03-F12. Attenuation here is typical installed performance, not a G.652.D limit: 0.35 dB/km at 1310 nm sits under the recommendation's 0.40 dB/km maximum (1310-1625 nm), and 0.21 dB/km at 1550 nm under its 0.30 dB/km maximum (1530-1565 nm). 1490 nm is a typical, interpolated value: no ITU-T recommendation publishes a 1490 nm attenuation figure of its own (G.652.D's 0.40 dB/km maximum spans 1310-1625 nm but is not a 1490 nm specification), so 0.22 dB/km bridges the two published windows and is not a citation. Why this rung exists: the duct family shipped 12/24/48/72/96/144, and cableFor answers with the SMALLEST cable that fits, so a span of 25 to 36 fibres was bought as 48F - twelve to twenty-three unused fibres in every metre of drum, and the design objective is fibre-metres, so that spare capacity is charged to the candidate that carries it. Measured on this engine, design.cableFor(36, DEFAULT_LADDER, registry) answers g652d-loose-48 for a 1,200 m span: 48 x 1,200 = 57,600 fibre-metres against 36 x 1,200 = 43,200 for a 36F rung, 14,400 fibre-metres the design never lights. With this model in the ladder the same call answers g652d-loose-36. Thirty-six strands is an ordinary run, not a special: three 12-fibre distribution legs leaving one joint, a 1:32 splitter site with four strands held for spares and for the next site, or 36 ONTs at a strand each. drumM 2,000 is the put-up to order rather than a figure from a vendor sheet - the same 2 km default the 24/48/96 rows carry - so set it to the reel actually bought; the engine rounds drums once per cable model on the aggregated design length, so a 2,500 m run bills two reels (4,000 m) of THIS cable, not two 48F reels. The row reaches a design only when the ladder names it: DEFAULT_LADDER in engine/design.js lists 144/96/48/24/12 and no 36, so the shipped default still buys 48F for a 36-fibre span. Pass this model in the design ladder option (the API validates every ladder entry against this catalogue) or add it to the default in an engine change - the part alone does not re-rank existing designs. All three attenuation figures are typical values: replace them with the bought cable's test report for a construction-grade budget.
